caption_recommended:
some people say they are not hungry.

then take one bite.
then the best bite.
then somehow the plate has become a shared property.

and love is the person who stops arguing with the pattern
and just orders extra.

maybe love is not keeping plate score.
maybe it is knowing your order anyway.
caption_alt: Send this to the person who says they are not hungry and then eats the best bite from your plate.
